claims.text: The company itself flags volatility in Indian attrition as an ongoing risk, tying it to wage increases, share price movement and competitor hiring — the closest thing to an audited satisfaction number that exists here.
The 20-F also names hybrid-work friction directly: employee preference for remote working set against client expectations of return-to-office is listed as a risk to attrition and client satisfaction.

gaps.reason: rating platforms (Glassdoor, AmbitionBox, Indeed) offer no free structured access and are not scraped by this tool, so no rating or rating trend could be sourced
gaps.suggested_fallback: read the quarterly attrition percentage in the last four results releases (BSE announcements) — it is audited, dated and specific, unlike a rating; then search the rating sites yourself for colour
